Learned counsel for the petitioner files memo of date stating following :
"In the above mention case the petitioner does not want to proceed with further.
Hence the petitioner may kindly be permitted to withdrawal of the bail application."
The memo is taken on record.
2. On 6th May, 2024 following order was passed.

"1. Under S.439 of Cr.P.C. the BLAPL has been filed by the petitioner, now in jail custody in connection with Khajuripada P.S. Case No.40 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.22 of 2023 pending in the court of learned Additional District &
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Phulbani, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/506/419 of the IPC read with sections 4(2)/6(1) & 12 of the POCSO Act and read with sections 66-E/66-B/66-D of the IT Act.
2. Since the earlier BLAPL No.8351 of 2023 was disposed of by this Bench, in view of the Standing Order No.2 of 2023 dated 21.05.2023, the matter has been listed before this Bench.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in the meanwhile after rejection of the earlier application for bail some prosecution witnesses have been examined and he seeks to leave to rely on the statement of those prosecution witnesses.

Accordingly,
it is submitted that he shall obtain copies of the depositions to renew the prayer for bail by the petitioner.

Copies of the depositions, if any that may be obtained by the learned counsel for the petitioner shall also be provided to the learned Additional Government Advocate.
4.
Learned Additional Government Advocate for the State seeks accommodation to obtain the connected disposed of case records so as to enable him to go through the case diary.
5. Registry shall tag the scanned copy of disposed of bail application(s) for reference.

Learned counsel for the petitioner shall file an extra copy of the petition in the Registry so as to send the same to the learned court in seisin of the matter who shall forward the copy through its office to the informant/victim informing them regarding their right of audience in the present petition.

An extra copy shall also be provided to the learned Additional Government Advocate so as to enable him to transmit the same to the informant/victim through the I.O. informing them regarding their right of obedience in the present proceeding.

6. The Secretary, DLSA shall do the needful for providing legal aid to the informant/victim for exercising right of audience in the present proceeding, if they are unable to engage any counsel on their own.
The legal aid counsel if engaged shall have the liberty to appear through the nearby virtual court room of the High Court of Orissa.
The court in seisin of the matter as well as the concerned I.I.C. shall also intimate the next date of listing of the matter.

7. List on 21.06.2024/when this Bench sits next."
3.
Today when the matter is taken up none appears for the informant/victim though efforts were made to inform them through the learned court in seisin as well as learned counsel for the State.
4. In view of the above, petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
